body.name: Tool Episode Quarantine Body
body.purpose: Prepare a review-only bridge from verified tool experience into a candidate structured training episode without automatically admitting evidence as training data.

inputFields.description: Digest-only structured conversation witness from the Waldo Mirror experiment.
Verified public-safe tool experience and its evidence references.
Explicit review and quarantine policy for any later training candidate.

outputFields.description: A candidate declaration that still requires separate review before any training use.

steps.description: Validate the conversation witness identity and retain only its declared digest boundary.
Validate that the tool experience is independently evidenced and public-safe.
Bind the exact episode evidence to an explicit review policy without granting training authority.
Emit a review-only training candidate declaration with evidence and policy lineage preserved.

qualityClaims: Evidence does not become training data automatically.
The candidate remains bound to the exact conversation and tool-experience lineage.
A separate explicit review remains required before any training use.
